notes: Ethereum mainnet, chainId 1. Resolve $poolManager to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and $token to the factory-deployed SIMDTEST. Deploy SIMDTESTHook directly using CREATE2 with permission mask 0x20cc (8396). It creates its immutable SIMDTESTVault in its constructor. No wrappers, owners, setters, proxies or upgrade paths. Mint the full 1e27 token units to the factory; factory alone handles 90% pool seeding, the external 10% swarm allocation and remainderTo. Pool LP fee stays static at 12500. IMD hook fees are separate: 30% at deployment block, linearly decreasing by 3 percentage points per block to zero at block+10, plus permanent 1% staking fee. Accrual is via swap deltas and ERC-6909 IMD claims; permissionless sweep redeems anti-snipe fees to 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985 and staking fees to hook.vault(), then calls notifyReward. Vault recognizes cumulative accrued fees before stake changes, preventing capture of unswept historical rewards. Fees earned without stakers are queued for the next first staker. Initial price in this manifest is provenance only; the launch factory computes the economic opening price. Deploy and initialize atomically in the same block because the fee clock starts at hook construction. See README.md and docs/review.md for deployment responsibilities and validation limits.
